O1_carry_share_allocation.baseline_B0: s_i = (P_CARRY_SHARE_L5 * n5 + pi_share_position * 1) / (n5 + 1), n5 = P_APPS_L5, pi_share_position = training mean carry share of the position class
O1_carry_share_allocation.challenger_C1: s_i from a binomial-likelihood logistic model (rows replicated with weights y and N - y) on the role-state features (shares L5 / active-L5 / decay, per-appearance skill rates, participation features, depth competition, position dummies, team pass rate)
O1_carry_share_allocation.structure: Y_i | N ~ BetaBinomial(N, s_i * kappa_pos, (1 - s_i) * kappa_pos): the Dirichlet-multinomial marginal (zero mass arises from the share); kappa_pos by training-only maximum likelihood per position class (bounds [0.5, 500]) with the predicted shares fixed
O1_carry_share_allocation.target: player carries given the REALIZED team carry total N (allocation-only evaluation; the end-to-end mixture over the team-volume distribution is deferred to the simulator stage)

P1_player_participation.baseline_B0: (P_APPS_L5 + 2 * pi_position) / (5 + 2), pi_position = training participation rate of the position class
P1_player_participation.challenger_C1: L2 logistic regression (C=1.0) on position dummies, P_APPS_L3/5/12 rates, P_GAMES_SINCE_APP (cap 12), P_RETURNING, P_TRANSFER_NEWCOMER, the L5 / active-L5 / decay shares, TEAM_N_ACTIVE_CARRIERS/RECEIVERS_L5, T_PLAYS_B0, RATING_GAP, ABS_RATING_GAP, IS_HOME, O_IS_FCS, T_N_SEASON
P1_player_participation.target: 1 if the candidate has >=1 carry, reception or pass attempt in the target game (box-score participation; no snaps exist)

T1_team_rush_attempts.baseline_B0: NB2 with mean = T_RUSH_B0, dispersion alpha by training-only bounded maximum likelihood (mean fixed)
T1_team_rush_attempts.challenger_C1: NB2: sklearn PoissonRegressor(alpha=0.01) on ALL team / opponent / strength / schedule features of the shared state (training-only median imputation + missing indicators + standardisation) + the same dispersion procedure
T1_team_rush_attempts.target: rush_plays of the FBS offense in the game

T2_team_pass_attempts.challenger_C1: same C1 construction on the same features

constants.imputation: training-only median + explicit missing indicator for every continuous feature; standardisation on training rows

data.player_target_population: candidate rows of the point-in-time universe (FBS-vs-FBS only)
data.sportsbook: no sportsbook line / odds / spread / total anywhere
data.team_target_population: FBS offense team-games with play rows, target seasons 2019-2025 (FBS-vs-FBS and FBS-vs-FCS flagged)

end_to_end_and_simulator.convergence: CDF / Wasserstein-style stability for lattice outcomes (the NFL quantile R11 criterion is NOT used)
end_to_end_and_simulator.simulation_N: to be registered before any joint-simulator scoring

exposure_and_periods.2025: LATE_PERIOD_CONFIRMATION_PREVIOUSLY_EXPOSED (NOT scored in this milestone; scored once, after the architecture is frozen)
exposure_and_periods.2026_week_6_plus: CLEAN_FORWARD_CANDIDATE (earliest; Week 7 if the freeze is not legitimately complete)
exposure_and_periods.2026_weeks_1_4: BURNED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY (not present in the frozen research tables; unused in this milestone)
exposure_and_periods.fold_year_note: 2018 is warm-up because the frozen tables begin in 2018 (no earlier season exists for prior-season state); folds end no later than 2024
exposure_and_periods.honesty: every historical CFB season was exposed to the legacy system and to descriptive audits; NO pristine historical holdout is claimed

kind: PREDICTIVE PROTOCOL registered BEFORE any new-engine performance is inspected (RESEARCH / SHADOW ONLY)
legacy_comparison: deferred until an overlapping output exists: legacy context_v2 / champion models are scored on the SAME candidate universe, never on an easier conditional universe

metrics.bootstrap: 2-calendar-week moving blocks over pooled D1-D4 validation weeks, 10000 replicates, seed 20261003 (NOT an IID row bootstrap)
count: threshold calibration of P(Y>=k) at fixed lattice points (Brier + ECE)
slices: returning vs transfer-newcomer vs other (player components)
early season (<=3 team games) vs established
high vs low expected opportunity (baseline expectation above / below its training median)
low vs high data coverage (T_N_SEASON <= 3 or O_RATING_N <= 3)

prohibitions: no rescue tuning after any exposed period
no feature borrowing from legacy models
components not tested here keep status UNBUILT

promotion_gate_challenger_over_baseline.G1: relative mean-fold primary-loss improvement >= 0.5% (CRPS for counts, log loss for binary) OR pooled block-bootstrap one-sided 95% upper bound of mean loss delta < 0
promotion_gate_challenger_over_baseline.G3: mean-fold PIT KS (counts) not worse by > 0.02; ECE (binary) not worse by > 0.01
promotion_gate_challenger_over_baseline.G4: no eligible slice (>= min rows) more than 5% worse in the primary loss
promotion_gate_challenger_over_baseline.decision: a challenger replaces its baseline only if ALL gates pass; otherwise the SIMPLER baseline is retained; no rescue tuning, no re-cut of a failed challenger

state_features: all features come from cfb_shared_state_contract.json; constants fixed there
